label: Accessible name of a Space's Memory tab. {{space}} is the Space's name. "Space" is a product noun (a shared area of pages).
description: Subtitle on the Memory tab. Shared memory is a list of facts the Space's socios (AI agents) use; its editors approve each entry.
add: Button for an editor: adds a memory entry at once.
propose: Button for a member who isn't an editor: proposes an entry for the editors to approve.
missing: Shown when the Space doesn't exist or the person can't read it.
loading: On a Space's Memory tab while its entries load.
audience.who: First sentence of the Memory tab's intro: who reads the memory. _private for a private Space.
audience.use: Second sentence of the intro. "Socios" are AI agents.
audience.waits: Last sentence of the intro: where a proposal goes. _editor is shown to the Space's editors.
provenance.proposed: Who proposed a memory entry. {{person}} is a person's name; _socio forms add {{socio}}, a socio (AI agent) that proposed it on that person's behalf. The -in forms add the chat it came from: <chat> wraps {{chat}}, the chat's title, as a link; keep the tags.
provenance.proposed-in: As provenance.proposed, with the chat it came from: <chat> wraps {{chat}}, the chat's title, as a link; keep the tags.
proposals.title: Heading of the proposals section: the reader's own proposals, or (_editor) everyone's waiting for approval.
proposals.changes: On a proposal that changes an existing entry: {{text}} is the entry it replaces. _unknown when that entry isn't shown.
proposals.approve: Button for a Space editor on a proposed memory entry: approves it so the socios (AI agents) start using it.
proposals.edit-approve: Button: opens the proposal in an editor to reword it before approving.
proposals.reject: Button for a Space editor on a proposed memory entry: turns it down.
proposals.withdraw: Button for the proposal's author: takes it back.
entries.title: Heading of the entries in use.
entries.version: Badge on an entry changed before. {{version}} is its version number.
entries.approved-by: Under an entry: {{name}} is the editor who approved it. _unknown when their name isn't known.
entries.history: Accessible name and tooltip of the button that opens an entry's history.
entries.edit: Accessible name and tooltip of the pencil button: an editor edits (_editor), anyone else suggests a change.
entries.retire: Accessible name and tooltip: stops the entry being used; it moves to Retired.
entries.empty: Shown when the memory has no entries. "Invoices go out on the 1st" is an example entry; translate it. "socio" is an AI agent.
retired.title: Heading of retired entries (no longer used).
retired.by: Under a retired entry: {{name}} is who retired it. _unknown when their name isn't known.
retired.delete: Accessible name and tooltip of the button that deletes a retired entry.
retired.kept: How long retired entries are kept. {{count}} is the number of days.
retire-confirm.title: Title of the confirmation before retiring an entry.
retire-confirm.body: "Socios" are AI agents. "Retired" names the section the entry moves to.
delete-confirm.title: Title of the confirmation before deleting a retired entry permanently.
editor.title-approve: Title of the entry editor when an editor rewords a proposal before approving it.
editor.title-change: Title of the entry editor when changing an entry: a member suggests a change, an editor (_editor) edits it.
editor.title-new: Title of the entry editor for a new entry: a member proposes, an editor (_editor) adds.
editor.label: Label of the entry's text box.
editor.note: Note under the text box: a member's entry waits for approval; _now when it's used at once (an editor, or approving).
editor.rule: Second sentence of the note: what an entry should be.
history.title: Title of the dialog listing an entry's versions.
history.version: Badge on a version. {{version}} is its number.
history.proposal: Badge on a version that was only proposed, never in use.
history.decided: After a version's provenance: {{name}} is the editor who approved it, or (_rejected) rejected it. Lowercase: it follows " · ".
status.proposed: A version's state: it waits for an editor.
status.active: A version's state in an entry's history: the version socios (AI agents) use now.
status.superseded: A version's state: a newer version replaced it.
status.rejected: A version's state in an entry's history: an editor turned the proposal down.
status.withdrawn: A version's state: its author took the proposal back.
status.retired: A version's state: no longer used.
